availability.same_timestamp_rule: context streams expose events with ts_init < T only

outcome.strict_gap_rule: max_gap must be shorter than the horizon under strict, else a horizon with zero interior observations expires instead of censoring GAP

study.description: Descriptive dataset build for later ensemble trade management. Untreated flip-to-flip path: no stop, no target, no trailing exit, no higher-timeframe exit, no entry filter. Fixed-time observations are primary; milestone first-passage is secondary.
study.question: How do canonical confirmed 1m V_A flip-to-flip trades evolve through quick failure, slow deterioration and trend-runner states when viewed jointly with 5m/15m/1h regime state, higher-timeframe regime geometry, normalized structural levels and fixed-time path information?
